veranderings.voor: was al voor Edward Jenner bekend
veranderings.na: was al voor Edward Jenner se tyd bekend
veranderings.rede: 'voor Edward Jenner' can read as 'in front of Jenner'; 'voor Jenner se tyd' makes the time sense clear without changing the meaning.
'naboots' means imitate; for an experiment, 'herhaal' is the usual Afrikaans word, and it matches the previous sentence.
AWS writes the compound verb 'bekendmaak' as one word, so the past participle is 'bekendgemaak'.
